question_text: What group of people was taken and sold as slaves?

why_it_matters.text: Millions of people were taken from Africa and forced into slavery in the Americas. In the United States, slavery lasted from 1619 until 1865 — over 240 years. American freedom and prosperity were built, in part, on the unfree labor of enslaved people. Facing this honestly is part of being an American.

fun_fact.text: The first Africans were brought to Jamestown, Virginia in 1619.  Ending it required a civil war that killed more Americans than any other war in our history.
